text: The replay target `~/.omp/agent/sessions` omits sessions for named omp profiles. The repo runs agents with `omp --profile <name>` and stores their state under `~/.omp/profiles/<name>/agent/`; an empty/default-agent replay can undercount or miss the fleet data this acceptance is meant to measure.
evidence: var/agent-tmp/converge/r4/issues.jsonl:627 acceptance item 1; AGENTS.md:394-397 specifies profile-scoped state, not `~/.omp/agent/`.
fix: Replay the session directories for every named profile under `~/.omp/profiles/*/agent/sessions`, with the profile set and included-row counts recorded.
